objective.name: sandbox.dsl.remote.structure.create.read
objective.description: Create and read one remote structure across N5 before terminating locally.

#root.role: Create one remote structure on the other instance, read it back remotely, then consume the returned fields locally in a wrapper-backed terminal capacity.

effects.remote_structure_create: One structure is created on the remote instance.
effects.remote_structure_read: The committed remote structure is read across the external boundary.

transformation_contract.morphing: A local label becomes one terminal local summary after a structure is materialized and read on another Brique instance.
invariants: The remote structure is created from the local label and then read back remotely before terminal local consumption.
The terminal wrapper receives the committed remote functional.title and the remote structure_id, not only the create response.
success: The terminal payload exposes summary and ctx_id from sandbox.consume.record after the remote structure round-trip.
The remote read returns the same structure_id created on the remote instance and exposes functional.title equal to the input label.
failure: The flow fails if remote structure.create or structure.read fails across the external boundary.
The flow fails if the local terminal wrapper cannot consume the returned remote fields.
notes: This scenario validates remote structure lifecycle composition inside a local DSL orchestrator.
The terminal output is still local wrapper output even though the structure lifecycle occurs remotely.
